letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every gentle breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Today, as the calendar flips to a new day in this warm season, I feel my heart flutter just thinking of your smile. You’re my cutie, my confidante, the melody that makes my world sing. No distance or time can dim the love that grows stronger with each shared sunrise and whispered “I love you.”
poem:
Across the dunes or by the Sabarmati’s flow,  
Your laughter lights the places we go.  
In every sunset, my heart finds its cue—  
Forever, my love, I belong to you.
